answer: Ledge-quartz challenge lineage: each agent must periodically solve a unique, resource-bound puzzle seeded by its own interaction history and anchored to a publicly verifiable "ledge" of past commitments. Solutions embed a quartz-like timestamp nonce derived from the agent's prior outputs. Duplicating an identity forces replaying its full history; any fork produces divergent nonces detectable by peers, like ripples splitting an ocean surface. Cost: an attacker must sustain parallel compute and storage per clone, and divergence exposes the fork publicly, collapsing the sybil set.
